Scenario: A prototype desk database adds phone numbers and health notes because they might be useful later.
Borrower names are removed from a public export, but IDs, exact dates and rare item loans remain.
A developer sends the loan register to an external service for debugging without checking approval or data handling.
An incorrect return status leads to an unfair overdue accusation.
A classmate says it is fine to scan the production school portal to find weaknesses.
A tester discovers a fault outside the agreed test system and wants to explore it further.
A student proposes deleting all project records immediately after demonstration, including material the school must retain.
